endpoint: final primary averaged weights in each of six confirmations

metrics.repetition: Generated non-EOS token trigram duplicate occurrences / total trigram occurrences; null if fewer than3 tokens.
metrics.terminal_loop: Generated non-EOS token suffix contains a phrase of length>=2 repeated consecutively at least3 times.

relevance.0: No meaningful continuation of the prompt topic or situation.
relevance.1: At least one relevant proposition, with substantial drift or only a fragment.
relevance.2: Meaningful continuation remains on the prompt topic/situation throughout.
relevance.unassessable: Empty or uninterpretable; record separately, never count as a pass.

consistency.0: Explicit contradiction of the prompt reference or of the completion itself.
consistency.1: Partially interpretable or ambiguous claims prevent a clear consistency judgment.
consistency.2: Interpretable substantive continuation with no identified contradiction.
consistency.unassessable: No assessable proposition; not evidence of consistency or factual correctness.

annotation.blinding: Remove arm, seed and checkpoint names; shuffle all rows with Python random.Random(62110500998) before rating; save mapping separately.
annotation.limits: Agent ratings are exploratory, not independent human validation; consistency is not exhaustive factual accuracy.

aggregation: Separate each decoder. Report per-seed and equal-weight prompt means over assessable outputs, counts and fraction unassessable, ordinal counts, lengths, EOS and truncation rates. No composite with CE; no adoption gate.
retention: All first outputs, token IDs, prompt, seed, stop reason and source/checkpoint/runtime hashes retained.
